stem: A reviewer at Ashgrove Media wants a plan limited to one resource address and whatever depends on it, leaving the rest of a large configuration out of the preview. Which flag produces that?
rationale: -target focuses planning on resource instances matching a given address and whatever depends on them, which is exactly a narrowed preview. -refresh-only reconciles state rather than narrowing scope. -out only saves a plan to a file; it does not change which resources are considered. -destroy previews a full teardown of everything, the opposite of narrowing scope.
